videos.title: KPC Website NOW OPEN
videos.desc:
Our website is now open to everyone! Whether you chase parks, KFF references or summits, there's something for you: events, Kentucky parks, park notes, campgrounds and guides for POTA, WWFF and SOTA, all built to work on your phone right from the picnic table or the summit.
🔗 Take a look: https://kentuckyportableclub.github.io/KPC-Links/

🎵 Music: "Get Outside, Get On The Air" — made with Suno (suno.com). Used non-commercially.

videos.title: KPC 2027
videos.desc:
Join us for the 2nd Annual KY POTA Campout!

We had a such a great time this year, and next year will be even better. 

🗓️ Save the date: *24-26 SEP 2027*
🏕️ Location: *Taylorsville Lake SP (US-1271)*

*Find all the information on our website* https://kentuckyportableclub.github.io/KPC-Links/campout.html

Tell your friends - Share the flyer!  https://kentuckyportableclub.github.io/KPC-Links/KPC_2027_KYPOTA_Campout_Flyer.pdf

73, 
KY POTA Campout Committee
